usage:
import os

from openai import Client

client = Client(
    api_key=os.environ.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"),
)

result = client.admin.organization.certificates.create(certificate="string", name="string")
print(result)

fields.name: name
fields.description: An optional name for the certificate

fields.name: certificate
fields.description: The certificate content in PEM format

fields.name: object
fields.description:
The object type.

- If creating, updating, or getting a specific certificate, the object type is `certificate`.
- If listing, activating, or deactivating certificates for the organization, the object type is `organization.certificate`.
- If listing, activating, or deactivating certificates for a project, the object type is `organization.project.certificate`.

fields.name: id
fields.description: The identifier, which can be referenced in API endpoints

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: The Unix timestamp (in seconds) of when the certificate was uploaded.

fields.name: active
fields.description: Whether the certificate is currently active at the specified scope. Not returned when getting details for a specific certificate.
